name: veteran-engineering-studio
description: End-to-end software engineering with a web-first Veteran Machine Bridge, specialist frontend product design, Python Agent engineering, repository/runtime takeover, debugging, release/operations, Figma/design-system workflows, accessibility, and rendered QA.

interface.shortDescription: Full-stack engineering with advanced Figma product design and visual QA
interface.longDescription: A two-skill engineering plugin with one accountable delivery path. Veteran Full-Stack Engineer owns repository-wide engineering and can use an explicitly connected Veteran Machine Bridge for workspace-bounded files and managed local processes from web-capable hosts. Frontend Design Builder owns material UI/UX design, Figma/design-system work, responsive interaction, accessibility and rendered visual fidelity.
defaultPrompt: Take ownership of this software task end to end, using the frontend design specialist whenever visual UI quality or design-system work is material.
Audit this product across engineering and UI quality, implement the highest-value fixes, and verify the real runtime result.
Build this feature as a production-quality vertical slice, including polished frontend behavior and rendered QA when applicable.
